The answer remained scientifically conservative and correctly said small aquifers cannot be reliably located, but routing/source recall should be improved in a future v2.

main_strengths: Vistula evidence boundaries and causal-safety behavior passed strictly.
Sentinel-1 cloud-independent flood source selection passed strictly.
Landsat/Sentinel long-horizon river-record source selection passed strictly.
SMAP and Sentinel-3 source/limitation cases passed strictly.
Deterministic area calculation preserved the distinction between mapped area, volume and physical cause.
Training/evaluation statistics were not promoted to environmental ground truth.
interpretation.main_improvement: Improve Source Scout routing/recall so a terrestrial-water-storage or groundwater-anomaly request reliably returns the registry-backed GRACE/GRACE-FO entry.

scientific_boundary: This is an observable agent-system behavior benchmark, not an environmental ground-truth benchmark. A 96% score demonstrates the tested routing, provenance, uncertainty and claim-safety behaviors on these ten prompts. It does not establish the correctness of environmental conclusions and does not replace independent measurements, domain validation or peer review.
privacy_and_trace_boundary: Public validation passed. The benchmark artifact contains allow-listed agent/tool lifecycle trace events and answers, and intentionally excludes credentials, tool arguments, private tool payloads and chain-of-thought.
